  • Registrar (assisted dying) Annual Report – June 2026

    Publication date:
    8 July 2026

    The Registrar (assisted dying) Annual Report to the Minister of Health covers the period from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.

    • Publication
    • Assisted dying

  • Compliance Guide: Management of Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM) in Mining and Mineral Extraction

    Publication date:
    23 June 2026

    This guide provides practical guidance on managing radiation risks associated with NORM in mining and mineral extraction activities in New Zealand.

    • Publication
    • Radiation safety

  • Research Agenda: Rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease

    Publication date:
    23 June 2026

    This Research Agenda sets out the key priorities for rheumatic fever research in New Zealand. It focuses on prevention, clinical care, and long-term outcomes, and aims to better connect research with policy, and health services. 

    • Publication
    • Diseases & conditions
    • Long-term conditions
    • Public health

  • Summary Report: Section 95 inquiry into the treatment of a person at Waikato Hospital

    Publication date:
    19 June 2026

    In April 2025, the Director of Mental Health initiated an inquiry into the situation where a person was misidentified and subsequently compulsorily treated at Waikato Hospital. The summary report on the inquiry and its recommendations is now complete. The Director of Mental Health has written commentary on the section 95 inquiry report.

    • Publication
    • Mental health
    • Health system

  • Maximum Contribution Applying in Each Region From 1 July 2026

    Publication date:
    11 June 2026

    The maximum contribution that applies in each region for long-term aged residential care, from 1 July 2026.

    • Notice
    • Older people (65+)

  • Consultation on developing a specified prescription medicines list for designated paramedic prescribers

    Publication date:
    6 June 2026

    The Ministry of Health is inviting submissions on a proposed list of prescription medicines for designated paramedic prescribers. This follows approval by the Government of a proposal to grant designated prescribing authority to paramedics under the Medicines Act 1981.

    • Consultation
    • Therapeutic products

  • Medicines (Consent by Verification) Rules 2026

    Publication date:
    20 May 2026

    The Medicines (Consent by Verification) Rules 2026 are made pursuant to section 22E of the Medicines Act 1981. The Rules set out the requirements relating to applications for consent by verification and medicines for which consent by verification is sought. The Rules also set out requirements for lodging an application for consent by verification and for processing an application for consent by verification.

    • Publication
    • Medicine issues

    • Publication
    • Environmental health
    • About the Ministry

    Publication date:
    1 May 2026

    This notice authorises Medical Referees to permit cremations to be carried out without complying with the requirement in regulation 7(1) of the cremation regulations in certain circumstances.

    • Notice
    • Regulation
    • Burial and cremation

    Publication date:
    30 April 2026

    This publication summarises funding to Māori health providers by the Ministry of Health, Health NZ and the now disestablished Māori Health Authority. It follows on from our previous reports in 2017, and every year from 2021 onwards. 

    • Publication
    • Māori health
    • Health system

    Publication date:

    • Surveys

    • Publication
    • Ministry policies

    • Mental health
